page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1.8xlarge is a storage-focused server instance belonging to the ecs.d1 family. It is powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor operating at 2.5 GHz, delivering 32 dedicated physical cores on the x86_64 architecture with a single thread per core. The instance is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

A defining characteristic of this instance is its massive local storage capacity, featuring 94489 GB of local HDD storage. This high-density storage configuration is paired with a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps. The virtualization layer is managed via the KVM hypervisor, ensuring dedicated resource allocation without CPU thread sharing.

The primary tradeoff of the ecs.d1.8xlarge is its reliance on traditional HDD storage rather than solid-state drives, which limits random read and write performance but offers high capacity at a lower cost per gigabyte. Additionally, the Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 CPU represents an older processor generation. This makes the instance highly cost-efficient for sequential data access and large-scale storage workloads where raw IOPS are less critical than overall storage volume.

Given these specifications, the ecs.d1.8xlarge is suited for workloads requiring massive storage capacity and sequential data processing. Appropriate use cases include large-scale data warehousing, log processing, MapReduce jobs, big data analytics, and cold storage archiving.
